title: Nudge pending approvals after 4h, expire after 24h
body:
Closes #30

## Why
A pending approval never changed state: a missed card was never re-raised, the model was told it "will be told", and a click days later still approved a stale action.

## What
- \`approvals_next\` / \`approvals_tick\` activities (core) and store helpers. \`SessionWorkflow\` arms one timer for the earliest nudge/expiry (alongside the digest timer), guarded by \`workflow.patched("approval-expiry")\`.
- Nudge once at \`AOA_APPROVAL_NUDGE\` (4h); expire at \`AOA_APPROVAL_EXPIRE\` (24h). Both notices go through the notifier as \`alert\` (wait out quiet hours, skip spacing), with idempotent client keys.
- Tool: an expired approval returns "lapsed, NOT done, ask again". Server: a late click is 409 "expired". Slack bridge shows that message instead of "already decided".
- README, CLAUDE.md, .env.example, session log.

## Testing
- Unit: nudge once, expiry, idempotent second tick, tool message, no late approval, 409 detail.
- Temporal e2e: no click ever arrives; timers nudge then expire (2s / 5s settings).
- Full suite 175 passed.
